title: Supply and integrate core tax & customs systems
description: TRA is modernising IDRAS/TANCIS-era systems, automating core processes and integrating 90→300 systems — large procurement and integration work.

title: Build analytics & AI risk models
description: Demand for AI/ML fraud and risk models, analytics-driven eligibility and a unified data platform.

title: Provide cybersecurity & data-governance services
description: As systems and data grow, TRA needs cyber defence, data-quality and governance tooling and audits.

title: Formalise and serve informal-sector taxpayers
description: Bringing the informal economy into the tax net opens fintech, registration, and simple digital-service markets.

title: Digital payments & non-resident digital taxation
description: Integrating digital payment channels and taxing non-resident digital services creates fintech and data-sharing plays.
evidence: Digital payment channel integration; non-resident digital revenue KPIs.

title: Deliver training, e-learning & certification
description: ITA is expanding programmes, e-learning platforms and public certification — content, LMS and delivery partners are needed.

title: Construct campuses, offices and staff housing
description: An ITA Academic Building, Misugusugu campus, office and staff-housing works and renovations are planned.
evidence: Completion KPIs for Academic Building and Misugusugu (0→100%).

title: Trade-facilitation & logistics services
description: Halving clearance time and the AEO programme reward efficient logistics, brokers and compliant traders.
evidence: Clearance time 8→4 days; AEO consignment inspection falling 15→10%.

title: ESG advisory & implementation
description: ESG is being institutionalised from a 0% base across governance, operations and performance.

title: Research, policy briefs & consultancy
description: Research proposals, EOIs, RFPs, external consultancies and journal output are all targeted to grow.

title: Change-management & transformation advisory
description: A workforce and systems transformation needs adoption, communication and capability partners.

title: Enterprise risk & assurance services
description: Risk registers, ERM committees and internal-control targets create assurance and audit-tech demand.

title: Third-party data partnerships
description: TRA plans many new data-sharing agreements to widen compliance intelligence — data providers can partner.
evidence: New data-sharing agreements 47 baseline; third-party data integration.

title: Health, wellness & NCD/HIV services
description: Staff wellness, screening, counselling and NCD/HIV programmes are funded across ~13,000 staff.

title: Develop TRA workforce careers
description: The workforce grows from 8,775 to 13,428, with priority on ICT, analytics, audit and enforcement roles.

title: Fund and co-finance transformation
description: A ~TZS 10.6tn plan front-loads ICT capital and welcomes development-partner support — co-financing and vendor finance openings.
evidence: CP-7 financial requirement ~TZS 10,596bn; DP support assumed.

title: Supply working tools, equipment & vehicles
description: Planned procurement of logistics items, working tools, equipment and facilities across the plan.
evidence: Planned tools/equipment and logistics procurement KPIs (80→98%).

title: Taxpayer education & media campaigns
description: Taxpayer education, communication channels and informal-sector awareness campaigns scale up.
evidence: Communication channels 7→12; awareness campaigns; customised comms.

title: Build a compliance-tech / regtech startup
description: Automation, self-service, e-filing and analytics create room for local regtech and taxpayer-facing products.
evidence: Self-service features 5→30; automation and e-services expansion.

title: Skills & curriculum partnerships with ITA
description: ITA seeks strategic partnerships, staff/student exchange and joint research with academia.
evidence: Partnerships, exchanges (10→80) and joint research KPIs.
